gates.evidence: Tenant routes require authenticated admin role and derive tenantId from the authenticated actor; tenantId is not accepted from request payload as scope authority.
gates.limitation: Authenticated HTTP denial must still be exercised against a deployed runtime.

gates.evidence: Tenant list and item reads include owner_scope='tenant' and server-derived tenant_id predicates.
gates.limitation: Cross-tenant 404 behavior is not runtime-certified by static inspection.

gates.evidence: Platform routes require the platform super-administrator guard and select platform-owned records only.
gates.limitation: Role matrix and session revocation require authenticated runtime tests.

gates.evidence: Existing migration declares UPDATE and DELETE prevention triggers; run records remain append-only.
gates.limitation: Production database trigger behavior must be confirmed by deployment/runtime evidence.

gates.evidence: Tenant and platform save paths compare stored content digest and reject conflicting reuse of a run ID.
gates.limitation: Concurrent duplicate submissions require deployed race testing.

gates.evidence: Save endpoints reject runs unless simulationOnly=true and realWorldEffects, productionMutation, deviceCommandSent are all false.
gates.limitation: This does not certify vendor simulators, hardware, or physical effects.
